zh.title: 立榮與華信申請停飛花蓮航線 民航局審查中
zh.summary: 立榮與華信航空已申請停飛三條花蓮航線，民航局表示相關申請正在審查中。
body: 立榮航空與華信航空相繼向交通部民用航空局提出申請，規劃停飛共三條往返花蓮的國內航線。民航局於2026年8月17日證實已收到相關申請，目前均在審查階段。
根據民航局統計，今年1月至6月期間，立榮航空台北至花蓮航線的平均載客率僅為24.2%。立榮航空表示，北部旅客往返花蓮高度仰賴陸路交通，空運需求偏低，因此於6月底申請停飛台北至花蓮航線，盼將有限運能轉投入需求較大的離島航線。
此外，華信航空亦申請停飛台中至花蓮與高雄至花蓮航線，上半年載客率分別為57.5%及42.8%。民航局指出，對立榮航空的申請正在審查中；針對華信航空的申請案，經初步檢視資料後已要求業者提供補充資料。

en.title: UNI Air and Mandarin Airlines Apply to Suspend Hualien Routes, CAA Reviewing
en.summary: UNI Air and Mandarin Airlines applied to suspend three Hualien routes, which the CAA is reviewing.
body: UNI Air and Mandarin Airlines have submitted applications to Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration to suspend a total of three domestic routes serving Hualien. The aviation regulator confirmed on August 17, 2026, that it received the filings, which are currently under review.

According to CAA statistics, UNI Air recorded an average load factor of 24.2 percent on its Taipei-Hualien route between January and June. UNI Air stated that northern travelers rely heavily on overland transport, resulting in low air travel demand, prompting its end-of-June application to reallocate capacity to offshore island routes.

Mandarin Airlines has separately applied to end its Taichung-Hualien and Kaohsiung-Hualien flights, which logged load factors of 57.5 percent and 42.8 percent respectively. The CAA noted that UNI Air's request remains under review, while Mandarin Airlines was asked to supply additional documentation following an initial data check.

zh.title: 中華航空連續4年獲亞洲最佳企業雇主獎 組織團隊指標得高分
zh.summary: 中華航空連續4年獲亞洲最佳企業雇主獎；組織團隊指標奪最高分
body: 中華航空於2026年8月17日發布新聞稿宣布，公司連續第4年獲得「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」。在本次評選中，華航於「組織團隊」指標表現尤為亮眼，獲得最高分數，反映出內部員工對團隊合作氛圍及整體工作環境的肯定。
2026年台灣區共有330家企業參與「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」評選。華航指出，公司視員工為重要資產，提供具市場競爭力的薪資、優待機票與員工持股信託等福利，並深耕人才培育與職能訓練。
此外，華航今年以工作與生活平衡為核心，舉辦員工日系列活動與健康紓壓日，邀請員工及眷屬參訪華航園區與修護工廠，並透過多方溝通機制及ESG人才永續策略，建立開放共融的職場文化。

en.title: China Airlines Named Best Company to Work for in Asia for Fourth Year
en.summary: China Airlines wins the Best Companies to Work for in Asia award for a fourth consecutive year.
body: China Airlines announced on August 17, 2026, that it has been awarded the Best Companies to Work for in Asia title for the fourth consecutive year. In the latest evaluation, the carrier achieved its highest score in the organizational team indicator.

A total of 330 companies in Taiwan participated in the 2026 evaluation process. China Airlines stated that it provides competitive compensation, discounted air tickets, and an employee stock ownership trust, while actively supporting employee talent development and career training programs.

The airline added that it continues to focus on work-life balance by organizing employee family events, including visits to the China Airlines park and maintenance facilities, while promoting an open workplace culture through multi-channel communication and ESG talent sustainability strategies.

zh.title: 日本樂天與德國Helsing合作推動攻擊型無人機引進日本
zh.summary: 樂天集團攜手德國Helsing；向陸上自衛隊提案攻擊型無人機；考慮日本國產化
body: 日本樂天集團將與德國國防新創企業Helsing展開合作，向陸上自衛隊提案採用Helsing的攻擊型無人機，協助將相關產品引進日本，並考慮在日本國內實現無人機國產化。
Helsing開發搭載人工智慧、具備攻擊能力的自律型無人機，並已供應給烏克蘭，未來也預計供貨給德國聯邦國防軍。由於Helsing目前在日本尚無實績，樂天將作為雙方合作窗口，協助引進相關產品。
接下來預計除了在陸上自衛隊進行Helsing無人機的實證測試外，也將共享最新產品資訊，以促成後續採購。若要在日本國內量產無人機，雙方也將進行合作。
日本政府預計於2026年內修訂安全保障相關三文件，屆時將提出強化國內無人機量產基礎的方針。

en.title: Rakuten Partners with Germany's Helsing to Bring Attack Drones to Japan
en.summary: Rakuten and Helsing to propose AI attack drones to JGSDF; consider domestic production in Japan
body: Japan's Rakuten Group will partner with German defense startup Helsing to propose Helsing's attack drones for adoption by the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF), help introduce the products to Japan, and consider domestic production of drones.

Helsing develops AI-equipped autonomous drones with attack capability and has supplied them to Ukraine, with future deliveries planned for the German Bundeswehr. As Helsing has no track record in Japan, Rakuten will serve as the cooperation partner to facilitate introduction of the products.

Plans include conducting demonstration tests of Helsing drones with the JGSDF and sharing latest product information to promote subsequent procurement. The two sides will also cooperate if drones are to be mass-produced domestically in Japan.
The Japanese government plans to revise its three security-related documents within 2026, when it will set out a policy to strengthen the domestic drone production base.
